ip_data_security.text: The online service provider will be able to identify and produce full text copies of requested scientific papers and standards in the fields of medicine, psychology, sociology, human factors, injury care, injury prevention, engineering (to include aerospac e engineering, civil engineering, electric engineering), materials science, and transportation at a minimum. 3.0 REQUIRED FEATURES AND SERVICES 3.1 The online service provider shall present full text scientific papers and standards including data necessary for scientific citations. The online service provider shall ensure lowest cost option for each paper or standard, ensure copyright permissions are appropriately obtained and maintained, ensure attempts to re-purchase papers are evaluated for need and the ability to share information (no duplicate purchasing). When documents are requested that may require additional time to acquire (such as those not available electronically) the provider shall notify the requestor of the anticipated delay to ensure the item is still desired. The expected transaction time for the service provider from initial request to the NTSB acquiring the item shall be less than 24 hours at least 85% of the time. 3.2 The system must provide online access from anywhere at any time to support
